title: Stateful setup for Read/Write Multiple Registers
purpose: Prime server register state with a valid 0x10 request and then exercise function 0x17 in a deeper valid sequence.
expected_behavior: Server should first parse a valid 0x10 write of one holding register at 0x0010, then parse a valid 0x17 request that reads one register from 0x0010 and writes one register at 0x0020.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use complete MBAP headers with protocol_id 0x0000.
Message 0 length 0x0009 matches unit_id plus 8-byte PDU for function 0x10 with quantity 0x0001 and byte_count 0x02.
Message 1 length 0x000f matches unit_id plus 14-byte PDU for function 0x17.
Function 0x10 fields preserve address, quantity, byte count, and register data ordering.
Function 0x17 fields preserve read address, read quantity, write address, write quantity, byte count, and write data ordering.
issue_safety_notes: This sequence is stateful for coverage only and remains conservative and fully framed.
